text: [One-line pitch: what it does and who it is for.]
[The problem your users face, in one or two sentences. Make it concrete — a real situation, not a vague complaint.]
[How your product solves it, in one or two sentences. What changes for the user.]
[Who the customers are and how big the opportunity is. One or two numbers, with their source.]
[What the product does today: the three things a user can do with it. Keep it to what exists, not what might exist.]
[How you make money: who pays, how much, and how often. One sentence per revenue stream.]
[Who is building it, and what you are asking for: the amount, what it funds, and what it unlocks.]
